provenance.method: deterministic local raster pixelization from an existing Ruohan PNG reference
provenance.palette: Target at most 40 colors per frame; observed 27-32 RGBA values including transparency.
provenance.alpha: Binary alpha only (0 or 255); transparent corners; no baked background.
provenance.notes: Two built-in image generation attempts failed to connect and produced no asset. No retained generator script was found, so exact bit-level regeneration is not claimed. Source and output hashes are documented externally and remain verifiable.
